image_description: A close-up view of a high-fidelity bookshelf loudspeaker. The speaker features a dark grey, rectangular enclosure with a prominent gold-colored woofer cone surrounded by a black rubber surround. Above the woofer is a smaller dome tweeter housed in a recessed cavity. A circular port is visible at the bottom of the front baffle. To the left, a portion of a second speaker with a wood-grain finish is partially visible.
